name: socialchamp-mcp
description: Manage your Social Champ social media from Claude - channels, posts, AI content, queue, approvals, and shareable calendars.
long_description: Connect Claude to Social Champ with one click. On first use a browser window opens for you to sign in to Social Champ and approve access (OAuth) - no API keys to copy or paste. Claude can then list connected channels and workspaces, create and schedule posts, generate AI content (posts, images, rewrites, hashtags), run bulk actions, control the publishing queue, manage labels, handle agency approval workflows, and create shareable calendars. This extension connects to the hosted Social Champ MCP server (mcp.socialchamp.com) via the mcp-remote bridge.

tools.name: create_image_post
tools.description: Create and optionally schedule an image post to one or more channels. After successful scheduling, ask whether to view posting calendar, check scheduled posts, or create another post.

tools.name: create_text_post
tools.description: Create and optionally schedule a text post to one or more channels. After successful scheduling, ask whether to view posting calendar, check scheduled posts, or create another post.

tools.name: update_post
tools.description: Update an existing post by postId. Text maps to upstream message, and the post profile is auto-resolved from the existing post unless one channelId override is provided.

tools.name: delete_post
tools.description: Delete an existing post by postId, such as canceling a scheduled post.

tools.name: get_channel
tools.description: Fetch details for a single connected channel by channelId. After returning details, suggest posting or viewing that channel's posts.

tools.name: location_search
tools.description: Resolve a free-text place query (e.g. 'Eiffel Tower', 'Starbucks Seattle') into taggable location candidates for an FB_PAGE, IG_BUSINESS, or IG_DIRECT channel. Returns a list of { id, name, place }. Call this FIRST to obtain a valid `id`, then pass that location object to a post-creation tool (create_text_post / create_image_post / bulk_schedule) — only the `id` is honored when the post is published; a bare name/place is ignored. Other channel types do not support location tagging.

tools.name: get_channels
tools.description: List all connected channels for the account. After listing, suggest filtering channels or creating a post.

tools.name: get_filtered_channels
tools.description: List channels filtered by platform types and/or text search. After results, suggest creating a post or viewing posts for those channels.

tools.name: get_workspaces
tools.description: List available workspaces for the account. After listing, suggest viewing or creating shareable calendars.

tools.name: get_paginated_posts
tools.description: Browse post history with page and pageSize controls. After results, suggest next page, channel-specific posts, or scheduled posts.

tools.name: get_posts_for_channels
tools.description: Fetch posts scoped to specific channelIds with an optional limit. After results, suggest creating a post or checking scheduled posts.

tools.name: get_posts_with_assets
tools.description: Fetch posts that include media assets such as images or videos. After results, suggest creating an image post or viewing all posts.

tools.name: get_scheduled_posts
tools.description: Fetch upcoming scheduled posts with an optional limit. After results, suggest creating a new post or opening calendar views.

tools.name: get_calendar_view_options
tools.description: Return supported calendar viewing modes and capabilities. After results, suggest viewing scheduled posts or creating a shareable link.

tools.name: get_shareable_calendars
tools.description: List existing shareable calendars for a workspace. After results, suggest creating a new link or opening calendar views.

tools.name: create_public_calendar_link
tools.description: Create a shareable public calendar link for selected channels and date range. Before creating, ask whether the link should be password protected or open; if protected, collect an 8-20 character password.

tools.name: get_in_app_calendar_url
tools.description: Return the authenticated in-app Social Champ calendar URL. After results, suggest viewing scheduled posts or managing shareable calendars.

tools.name: update_shareable_calendar
tools.description: Update a shareable calendar by calendarId, including name, date range, password, isActive, or permissionRoles.

tools.name: approval_list_pending
tools.description: List posts awaiting approval, owned by the account. Returns up to 50 per call. Filterable by channel and team-member id. Use to answer 'what's pending review' or 'show me posts waiting on me'.

tools.name: approval_approve
tools.description: Approve a post that's awaiting review. The account must be in the workflow's approvers list for the active stage — if not, returns NOT_AN_APPROVER. Optional comment is recorded on the workflow history. Optional dateTime reschedules the post when the approval also moves it past the final stage.

tools.name: approval_reject
tools.description: Reject a post that's awaiting review. Same approver requirement as approval_approve. Optional comment is recorded; the post moves to DECLINED status and a notification fires to the post owner.

tools.name: approval_assign
tools.description: Send an approval reminder for a pending post. Wraps the dashboard's 'Send reminder' notification — fires to the workflow stage's approvers (the same set defined in the workflow template). When `email` is supplied, validates that person IS an approver before sending; pass it to assert someone specific is in the loop. Throttled at 1 hour per post — repeated calls return ALREADY_NOTIFIED. Note: this does NOT modify the workflow's approver list — to add someone, edit the workflow template in Settings.

tools.name: bulk_delete
tools.description: Delete many posts at once — past or future, by either an explicit id list OR a predicate (channels × date range × status × error state). DESTRUCTIVE: defaults to dryRun=true; the LLM MUST explicitly pass dryRun=false to actually delete after the user confirms. Cap is 500 posts per call — anything bigger needs scripting. Each delete also cancels its publish job. Note: queue_clear is the lighter primitive for 'clear my upcoming queue' — bulk_delete is for ad-hoc destructive cleanup (failed posts, posts on a deprecated channel, etc.).

tools.name: queue_reorder
tools.description: Reschedule many posts in one call. Takes a list of {postId, dateTime} pairs and applies each as a time-only update — useful for 'swap these two posts', 'shift Tuesday's batch to Wednesday', or 'pull the launch announcement up to morning'. Distinct from queue_pause (which freezes posts in place) and bulk_delete (which removes them) — this just moves their dateTime. Sequential per-post update so a failure on one doesn't roll back the others; per-item failures captured in `data.failures`. Up to 100 items per call.

tools.name: bulk_label
tools.description: Apply (or replace, or clear) labels on up to 200 posts in a single call. Use mode=add to union the supplied labelIds with each post's existing labels (default mode=replace overwrites). The response reports per-post failures so the LLM can re-try only the bad ones.

tools.name: generate_post
tools.description: Draft a social-media post body in the user's brand voice. Use when the user says 'write a post about X', 'draft something for our launch', 'give me an idea for Black Friday'. Produces text only — does not schedule. After successful generation, suggest scheduling it via 'create_text_post' or 'bulk_schedule', or refining via 'rewrite'.

tools.name: suggest_hashtags
tools.description: Generate a set of hashtags for a topic or an existing post. The Wizard returns a list — use it to enrich a draft post, populate a post-creation tool's text, or just answer 'what hashtags should I use for X'.

tools.name: rewrite
tools.description: Rewrite an existing post body — shorten, expand, or rephrase. Use when the user pastes a post and asks for a tweak ('make this shorter', 'tighten this up', 'rewrite more casually'). Returns the original + rewritten text so the LLM can show a diff.

tools.name: generate_image
tools.description: Generate up to 4 images for a post. Use when the user says 'make me an image of...', 'I need a hero shot for...', 'create some visuals for the launch'. Counts against the user's monthly image-generation quota (same meter the AI Wizard uses).

tools.name: queue_pause
tools.description: Pause publishing on one or more channels. Future posts can't be scheduled on a paused channel, and any upcoming posts already in the queue will be held without firing. Use 'queue_resume' to bring the channel back online. When channelIds is omitted, every channel in the resolved workspace is paused.

tools.name: queue_resume
tools.description: Resume a previously-paused channel. Lifts the per-channel user-pause flag and releases held posts back to their original slots — except on channels where billing has independently locked publishing, which stay frozen. The response reports billingLockedChannels separately so you can tell the user when a billing issue is what's still blocking publishes.

tools.name: queue_clear
tools.description: Bulk-delete upcoming scheduled posts in a date range, optionally filtered by channels. Defaults to fromDate=now (past posts are out of scope). Always call once with dryRun=true first to surface the count, then again with dryRun=false (or omitted) to actually delete — this is irreversible. Each delete also cancels its publish job.

tools.name: list_collections
tools.description: List the user's recycle collections. Each entry includes id, title, postCount and workspaceId. Use this before 'recycle_post' so the LLM can choose a target collection (or confirm the auto-resolved fallback).

tools.name: recycle_post
tools.description: Copy an existing post into a recycle collection so it re-publishes on the collection's recycle schedule. The original post is left untouched. If collectionId is omitted, the user's oldest collection in the resolved workspace is used; if the user has no collections, the response is a structured NEEDS_COLLECTION error so you can suggest creating one in the dashboard.

tools.name: bulk_schedule
tools.description: Schedule many posts in one call (up to 100). Each entry has its own text, channels, image/video URLs, and optional schedule time — useful for rolling out a content calendar, importing a CSV, or filling a queue. After successful scheduling, ask whether to view the calendar or check the queue.

tools.name: label_list
tools.description: List the post labels available in the user's workspace. Use this before applying a label to a post so the label exists. After listing, ask whether to create a new label, apply one to a post, or filter posts by label.

tools.name: label_create
tools.description: Create a new post label in the user's workspace. Returns the new label including its id, which can be used immediately with 'label_apply'. Errors with code DUPLICATE if a label with the same title (case-insensitive) already exists.

tools.name: label_apply
tools.description: Replace the labels on an existing post with the supplied list. Pass an empty `labelIds` to clear all labels from a post. The post must belong to the user's workspace.

tools.name: label_remove
tools.description: Remove specific labels from a post (without touching the rest). Use when the user says 'unlabel this post', 'remove the X tag', 'drop the label'. Different from 'label_apply' which REPLACES the full label set; this tool subtracts the named ids from whatever is already on the post. Pass empty `labelIds` to clear all labels.

tools.name: instagram_first_comment
tools.description: Set or update the first-comment text on a scheduled or published Instagram post. Common pattern: keep the caption clean and put hashtags + CTA + tracked link in the first comment. Only works on Instagram posts (FB_PAGE / TW / LinkedIn use captions directly). Replaces the existing first-comment if one is already set.

tools.name: delete_shareable_calendar
tools.description: Delete a shareable calendar by calendarId.
